effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.help: How much the model may deliberate before answering. Higher levels reason more but take longer; None asks it to answer directly.

webSearch.label: Web search
webSearch.help: Lets the model search the web for current facts. Searched queries are sent to external search engines.
webSearch.unavailable: This model can't use tools, so web search isn't available for it.
webSearch.unverified: This model hasn't been verified to run tools yet, so web search stays off for it.

creativity.label: Creativity
creativity.help: Controls creativity. Lower = focused, higher = creative.

diversity.label: Diversity
diversity.help: Controls word variety. Lower = predictable, higher = diverse.

config.noPublisherRecommendation: No sampling recommendation from this model's publisher; neutral defaults applied.

threshold.label: Compaction threshold
threshold.help: Older messages are summarized when the conversation fills this share of the model's context window. Lower: summarizes sooner and more often, keeping the conversation shorter. Higher: keeps more of it word for word and summarizes less often.

instructions.label: Custom instructions
instructions.help: Define custom instructions that guide how the AI responds. This will be applied to all messages in this conversation.
instructions.placeholder: Enter your custom system prompt here...
